full_judgment: (1) Notwithstanding any thing contained in any other law for the time being in force or in any contract, where any non-agricultural land is held under a lease in writing for a term of not less than twelve years specified in such lease, the tenant holding such land shall on the ex-piration of the period so specified he entitled to the renewal of such lease for perpetuity on such fair and reasonable rent as may be 1 (determined under chapter XIV of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. (E.B. Act No. XXVIII of 1951).
